title: A lock-free ring buffer
hints: Keep pointers to the header and to the first slot (just after the header). Both `Ring` objects compute the same pointers from the same memory, so they share the counters, exactly like two processes sharing a mapping.

The order of operations is the whole design: the producer writes the slot, **then** publishes `head` with release; the consumer loads `head` with acquire, **then** reads the slot, then publishes `tail` with release.
